summary: InnovAge Holding Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a secondary offering by a selling shareholder. Under a September 22, 2026 underwriting agreement with Barclays, Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo as representatives, the Selling Shareholder agreed to sell 10,000,000 firm shares at $9.25 per share, plus a 30-day option for up to 1,500,000 additional shares. The company receives no proceeds, and shares settled September 24, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The offering was made under an existing Form S-3 shelf registration statement. Watch for overhang, lock-up terms and the extent of the option exercise.
